summary: On an image-to-image request, how far the model is allowed to move away from the input image. 0 returns the input essentially untouched; 1 behaves as though no input image were supplied. Bedrock documents 0.35 as the default.
combines: Required, along with image, whenever mode is image-to-image; it has no meaning in text-to-image.

Lixpi only uses it on the Bedrock path, where there are no control endpoints, so each reference mode collapses onto image-to-image with its own constant: 0.65 for style-control, 0.35 for structure-control, 0.6 for style-transfer (stability-provider.ts:39).
Read it as the inverse of faithfulness: higher means more freedom to invent, not more influence from the reference.

usage.from: a pipeline-owned value selected by style, structure, or style-transfer routing mode
usage.what: Controls how far Bedrock may move from the primary reference after direct Stability control routes are degraded to image-to-image.

note: Derived internally from the provider-neutral reference role when Bedrock degrades reference routing to image-to-image.
